tasks.label: CMake: Build Raspberry Pi arm64 .deb (Native)
tasks.command: cmake --preset rpi-arm64 && cmake --build --preset rpi-arm64 && cpack --config build/rpi-arm64/CPackConfig.cmake -G DEB -B dist

tasks.label: Docker: Build Raspberry Pi arm64 .deb (Trixie)
tasks.command: docker run --rm --platform linux/arm64 -v "${workspaceFolder}:/src" -w /src debian:trixie-slim bash -lc "apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential g++ cmake ninja-build pkg-config file dpkg-dev python3 python3-pytest libgstreamer1.0-dev libgstreamer-plugins-base1.0-dev libglib2.0-dev && cmake --preset rpi-arm64 && cmake --build --preset rpi-arm64 -j && ctest --preset rpi-arm64 && cpack --config build/rpi-arm64/CPackConfig.cmake -G DEB -B dist"

tasks.label: Service Python: Lint, Typecheck & Pytest
tasks.command: python3 -m ruff check src test && python3 -m mypy && python3 -m pytest

windows.command: python -m ruff check src test && python -m mypy && python -m pytest

inputs.description: SSH target user@host for Raspberry Pi deployment (e.g. pi@raspberrypi.local)
